title: Moisson - Weapon Stats & Location (Expedition 33)
description: Moisson in Clair Obscur: Expedition 33 - which character uses it, its element and scaling, and exactly where to get it.

sections.title: Overview
sections.content: Moisson is a physical-element weapon used by Sciel. It scales with Agility (C), Luck (D).

sections.title: How to Get the Moisson
sections.content:
Location: Chromatic Moissonneuse drop.

Obtained from Chromatic Moissonneuse drop.

sections.title: Is the Moisson Worth Using?
sections.content: Scales off Agility (C), Luck (D). A physical-scaling weapon, so it fits any build that is not committed to a specific element.
